# Beads issues with no description, which scripts/check-bead-descriptions.sh
# accepts.
#
# Generated by scripts/check-bead-descriptions.sh --update-baseline.
#
# An issue listed here does not fail the gate; an issue missing from here does.
# The list is empty: every issue had a description when the gate landed, so an
# empty one from now on is a description that was lost or never written. Remove
# an entry once the description is back, because a stale entry says a bead has
# no description when it has.
